Why Qivomedia

Signage that behaves like a live app, not a slideshow.

Updates in about a second

Press save and every affected screen changes almost instantly over a live connection. No waiting for players to check in.

Keeps playing offline

Each screen stores its content and its full schedule, so it keeps switching to the right layout at the right time — even with no network.

Emergency alerts

Fire, evacuation or lockdown on every screen in seconds, in three languages, until you clear it. Connects to campus alert systems (CAP).

Layouts designed by AI

Describe the screen you want in plain words. The AI agent builds an editable layout you review before anything goes live.

Design studio

Split any screen into live zones.

Drag and resize zones, give each its own playlist of images, video, web pages and live widgets, and preview the result exactly as it plays.

  • Templates: full screen, L-bar, split, quad, portrait, video walls
  • Widgets: clock, weather, ticker, countdown, web page, HTML
  • Any resolution, from a kiosk to a 4K wall

Scheduling

See exactly what plays, and when.

Day-part by date, weekday and time window — overnight too. Higher priority wins, equal priorities rotate, and a week timeline shows every screen's plan before it goes live.

  • Screen groups by building, floor or department
  • Proof of play: every item recorded, even offline
  • Reports by day, content and screen, export to CSV
For universities

One platform for every faculty, building and screen on campus.

Central communications stays in control, departments manage their own screens, and every screen can switch to an alert in seconds.

Plan a campus pilot
Safety

Emergency alerts

Campus-wide or per building, above every schedule, until cleared. Accepts the standard alert format (CAP) from emergency systems.

IT

Self-hosted on campus

One Docker container on your own server. Content, accounts and reports never leave the university network.

Governance

Viewer, editor, admin and owner roles, and a full log of who changed what and when.

Organization

Screen groups

Organize screens by faculty, building or floor, and target content or alerts to exactly the right places.

Daily life

Live campus information

News, events, library hours, menus, weather and countdowns, scheduled by time of day and day of week.

Languages

French, Arabic and English
